notes.title: Important update for Oculus Quest users!
notes.content:
This is mentioned in the Spawn Gun Update patch notes, but I figured it would be good to repeat here.

I've gotten sporadic complaints that the plasma sword melee weapon feels too heavy in-game. I thought for a long time users just had weird standards of vr physics from other games or something. Turns out no, I'm just a dummy! The code I wrote for physical weapons ends up making them feel much more floaty on refresh rates lower than what I tested on, which was 90 Hz. It was a dumb mathematical error and I didn't test enough on Quest to notice it.

My lazy fix is just clamping the physics refresh rate to 90 or above, and this is now the default in this update. Should feel much better now!

If you have any problems or questions, let me know.

notes.title: Spawn Gun Update
notes.content:
This update adds the spawn gun, available for players who own the Sandbox DLC. This tool can spawn every enemy in the game, in any level. Just for fun! To access it, enter the Mutators menu in the main menu and enable the "Spawn Gun" mutator. It will now appear in your weapon inventory when you load into a level.

[previewyoutube=H4MTfs-zAeA;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition, here are the biggest bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed soft lock that occurs when you die while a checkpoint is saving
[*] Fixed weapons moving too slowly on headsets with lower refresh rates
[*] Fixed grenade launcher reload animation playing incorrectly after upgrading reload speed
[*] (Hopefully) fixed an edge case that would cause the game to overwrite your progress
[*] Improved explosion and ragdoll physics
[*] Improved water shader with more realistic lighting
[*] Fixed bug involving a chain reaction of a lot of explosive tanks
[/list]

I hope you enjoy!

[/list]

notes.title: Vertigo Remastered Now Available!
notes.content:
Woo! It's here! Play it now!

Make sure to check out the spectator options by clicking the camera icon in the upper right hand corner of the game window if you're a content creator, I've got some cool features cooked up there.

There's also a surprise addition - experimental asymmetric co-op which you can enable through the spectator options as well! Grab a friend to control a drone on keyboard and mouse and fight alongside you. Or against you. There are no rules.
